messages:
Nora: follow-up from today's infra all-hands re: GPU supply & autoscale. Two quick clarifications for leadership: can APAC customers pin reserved bursts to specific zones, and what is our default behavior when opportunistic capacity vanishes mid-burst?
Diego: short answers: pinning = supported for enterprise accounts via per-account allowlist (console beta); opportunistic failover = transparent retry to alternate pool, then degrade-to-smaller-model, then queue.
Sana: small ask from SEs: can we get an example of the per-account allowlist format so we can advise customers?
Diego: example (pseudo):
```
account_allowlist: ["ap-southeast-1", "ap-east-1"]
reserved_enabled: true
```
Note: console will present this as toggles but backend uses the allowlist.
Eli: runtime note: when switching pools mid-request we attempt seamless failover where possible. if request is already streaming we try to reattach stream; otherwise we return a retriable error to the client. SDKs should treat that as a transient failure.
infra-bot: scheduled canary: autoscaler v1.7 -> opportunistic-ap-east-1 at 04:00 UTC.
ProductOps: leadership asked about billing/surge controls during bursting. what are defaults?
Diego: default for opportunistic bursts = surge billing when usage exceeds baseline; reserved bursts billed under committed rates. per-account burst_cap exists (disabled by default) and will be visible in the console soon.
Nora: if burst_cap is hit, do we reject or queue? leadership prefers queue + degrade rather than hard reject.
Diego: implemented cascade now = quantized_small -> queue -> reject. customers can opt out of cascade.
Sana: ops follow-up: can we have a dashboard tile showing missed_tokens/sec per pool so we can trigger alerts early?
Eli: yes, SRE is adding pool-level missed_tokens/sec and p95 latency. Ryan will propose an alert: missed_tokens/sec > 50 for 5m -> notify on-call.
ProductOps: timeline Q: when will console let customers pin regions?
Diego: console beta next sprint (2 weeks), GA in ~6 weeks pending feedback.
Nora: action items: @Sana collect p95/opportunistic numbers, @Eli update runbook failover section, @Diego add playbook snippet + billing examples. I'll collate and send to leadership. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
Sana: will post numbers by tomorrow EOD.
Eli: will update runbook and link here after canary prep.
Diego: will add the allowlist example to the autoscale playbook and note cascade behavior.
Nora: closing thread, will bring up any leadership follow-ups in next infra sync.
